capabilities.description: List fixed report artifact revisions or read an exact report reference, including its pinned data and related evidence.

usage.purpose: List fixed report artifact revisions or read an exact report reference, including its pinned data and related evidence.
usage.inputs: 无 ref 分页列出 report 成果（limit 默认30）；有 ref 读该固定版本，include_checks=true 同时读取渲染回执。
usage.outputs: 列表为 {items,nextCursor?}；单项为资源 metadata、manifest 和可选 checks。
limitations: 旧 revision 的 rendered 只证明旧版本；未完成/未检查报告不冒充已验证成果。

capabilities.description: Render an exact published report revision through the host inspector. Return the persisted actual rendering receipt, viewport checks and diagnostics. Correct the component input, publish a new revision, and inspect that exact revision again.

usage.purpose: Render an exact published report revision through the host inspector. Return the persisted actual rendering receipt, viewport checks and diagnostics. Correct the component input, publish a new revision, and inspect that exact revision again.
usage.inputs: ref 为 components_show 返回的完整固定 report ArtifactRef。
usage.outputs: 宿主真实渲染检查回执，含状态、视口/运行时检查和 diagnostics，并保存到该版本 receipts。
prerequisites: 宿主报告渲染器可用；已发布该 ref。
limitations: rendered 才证明本次检查通过；失败根据具体诊断修正受控组件或数据，发布新 revision 再检查。无渲染器时明确未验证。
rendered 不等于可导出；receipt.exportability 是源级建议，真实静态准备检查另用 report_export_check。

capabilities.description: Preflight PDF and PNG for an exact published report revision without creating output files. Return supported formats and actionable reasons. Interactive publication/render success is independent; preflight does not verify final exported bytes or guarantee identical later output.

usage.purpose: Preflight PDF and PNG for an exact published report revision without creating output files. Return supported formats and actionable reasons. Interactive publication/render success is independent; preflight does not verify final exported bytes or guarantee identical later output.
usage.inputs: ref 为完整固定 report ArtifactRef；不按标题猜版本。
usage.outputs: {checked:"rendered-preflight",outputVerified:false,supportedFormats,formats,limits,binding}；每格式含 status/reasons；不返回 PDF/PNG 字节，不保存 rendered 验收回执。
prerequisites: 宿主报告渲染器及 report-export 检查接口可用。
limitations: 最终导出仍会检查内容/尺寸/32 MiB 预算；检查后的运行时状态可能不同。PDF 拒绝 shadow DOM、音视频/动画 SVG、不能忠实复制的字体/画布/资源。PNG 只保存静态视图，不保留交互。不能为通过导出而静默删掉证据或媒体。

capabilities.description: Validate a workspace JSON draft containing the complete host_reports_publish request, freeze its input, and return a small publication request with inputRef. Does not publish a report or edit the file.

path.description: Workspace UTF-8 JSON file containing the complete host_reports_publish envelope and inline input. Read host_reports_describe for the two schemas.

operation_id.description: Stable ID for this preparation. Retry unchanged drafts with the same ID; after successful preparation use a new ID when changing content or metadata.

usage.purpose: Prepare large structured reports without copying their complete content into another tool call.
usage.inputs: path and operation_id. The file is a host_reports_publish request: operationId, title, summary, provenanceKind, data (possibly []), input, and original optional metadata or fixed references. Full reports require input.lead, 1–6 input.highlights and nonempty input.content.sections. locale belongs to this outer envelope.
usage.outputs: provider and publication. Pass publication unchanged to host_reports_publish. inputRef names an immutable application/json resource; no report exists until publication succeeds.
prerequisites: The draft input follows the selected provider schema and contains the original research values and fixed references.
limitations: Schema and renderer errors identify the draft field; edit only that part and prepare again. No automatic rewriting of findings.
Omitted locale remains omitted for the host preference; preflight uses the widest existing language limits, and publication checks the actual host locale.
Prepared input does not bypass provider selection, immutable-reference checks or final report_check.

capabilities.description: Describe the single unified default, generic content blocks and saved user styles. Components can be combined side by side or vertically; analysis methods are independent.

usage.purpose: Choose general-purpose presentation and existing saved exact versions.
usage.outputs: default, blocks, saved. No selectable built-in presets.
limitations: Does not select or run analytical methods.

capabilities.description: Save user-requested declarative design tokens for exact-version reuse. The default report layout is unified; no selectable presets or arbitrary HTML/CSS/JS.

usage.purpose: Extend presentation and reuse styles managed inside Report.
usage.outputs: id, version and a publishable style selection.
prerequisites: A user-requested presentation change and a clear reason.
limitations: Does not change data or analysis; no arbitrary code. Publications retain their exact style version.

capabilities.description: Render the selected host report provider input into a self-contained report package. Called only by host.reports.publish; does not publish, select a provider, run analysis or replace missing data.

style.description: One unified blue/gray frameless layout. Omit style by default. Only use custom safe tokens or a saved exact style version for user-requested presentation changes; no presets, themes, raw CSS or scripts.

path.description: Safe packaged path; extension must match media_type. Changing MIME alone does not allow script extensions. Source files may remain in the workspace.

media_type.description: Inert MIME: application/json (.json), text/plain (.txt/.csv/.tsv/.md/.log), image/png (.png), image/jpeg (.jpg/.jpeg), image/webp (.webp). Case-insensitive; MIME parameters allowed. Scripts are not accepted as executable attachments.

assets.description: Inert attachments only. Prefer a complete fixed ref + entry declared in envelope references. Workspace source_path is read at rendering time, not represented as historical point-in-time evidence.

target.description: Use answer for components embedded in a concise answer; report keeps the report page. Fixed input_ref owns this value and cannot be overridden.

lead.description: 完整报告必填：直接回答用户核心问题的开篇结论，作为标题后独立正文展示；不是目录元数据 summary。仅使用已有结论，不补造分析。target=answer 的独立组件可省略。

tone.description: Financial gain/up: positive (green); loss/down: negative (red); zero: neutral. auto requires a numeric value; omit for ordinary metrics.

highlights.description: 完整报告必填：首屏1–6项关键结果，复用block.metrics.items的{label,value,tone?}。value为已有数值或短定性结论；不从正文自动提取，不必凑满6项，不加说明字段。target=answer可省略。 首屏仅作快速概览，不能替代正文趋势、比较或条件关系的图表设计。

input.description: Supplied document blocks, fixed data and controlled style. No research templates, calculations, HTML, CSS or scripts.

path.description: Literal packaged path matching input.assets[].path. Allowed extensions: json, txt, csv, tsv, md, log, png, jpg, jpeg, webp. Script extensions including py are not packaged attachments.

oneOf.description: Clickable packaged evidence links. Each path must match a real input.assets entry; labels and descriptions are escaped. Prefer within a final details appendix. Markdown relative links are not a substitute.

tone.description: Financial gain/up: positive (green); loss/down: negative (red); zero: neutral. auto requires a numeric value; omit for ordinary metrics.

column_tones.description: Optional one tone per column. null retains ordinary text; auto requires numeric cells; negative colours explicitly supplied loss amounts red. Drawdown and account-value columns use null. Zero and missing cells stay neutral.

columns.description: Optional explicit source columns. When omitted, infer from actual rows or the fixed data manifest; existing field mappings and data checks still apply.

usage.purpose: Host-only presentation service for supplied results.
usage.inputs: metadata/data/related/references/input. Reports require metadata.title, input.lead, 1–6 input.highlights and nonempty input.content.sections. target=answer is an independent component surface without a report skeleton. Optional input.style/assets preserve supplied styling and attachments; summary remains index metadata. Highlights provide a quick overview; use the appropriate body charts for trends, comparisons and conditional relationships.
usage.outputs: entry, files and presentation identity; host publishes the exact package.
limitations: No analytical execution; no HTML/CSS/script uploads.

capabilities.description: Publish a report or answer components in one call. The tool normalizes and validates; reports publish through the host-selected provider, while answer components retain independent JSON and copied attachments.
